prebossNodes.description: Number of pre-boss depths visited on a path; branching alternatives do not add levels.

restsPerAct.description: Number of mandatory rest depths; each rest depth has one visible node shared by every path.

branchColumns.description: Number of lanes at non-rest depths. Rest and boss nodes merge the lanes.

minimumThreatFloor.description: Earliest depth that may contain an elite or the final boss.

mapMode.description: Map visibility policy for configured routes; fog reveals the trail and next choices.
